ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels constitute approximately 75% of the visible surface, with low-intensity black pixels occupying the remaining 25% primarily along the trailing edges and in localized spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centrally located high-intensity white regions on both lobes. One distinct low-intensity circular spot on the mid-left lobe. Multiple low-intensity vertical linear bands and irregular spots on the right lobe. Low-intensity continuous contour along the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a pixel angle of approximately 38 degrees and a bounding-box depth equal to 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe trailing edge shows high-frequency, sharp-peaked serrations. Left lobe trailing edge shows irregular, rounded serrations with a large indentation near the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges follow an upward-curving concave trajectory; trailing edges exhibit a sigmoidal curve from the deep central notch to the pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular pixel clusters (barnacles) located at the distal tips of both lobes; larger cluster on the right tip containing approximately 15-20 individual circular nodes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel sets of dark linear pixel disruptions on the right lobe surface; three major vertical lines visible spanning the mid-section to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant linear scarring/rake marks on the right lobe; barnacle encrustations on both tips; notable segment missing or indented on the outer left trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Single isolated dark circular spot on the left lobe surface at approx coordinate (0.3x, 0.4y) relative to the fluke bounding box.
